nodes.label:
# products
id  PK serial
title  varchar
description  text?
category  varchar?
brand  varchar?
sku  varchar UNIQUE?
price  numeric(10,2)
discountPercentage  numeric(5,2) = 0
rating  numeric(3,2) = 0
stock  int = 0
minimumOrderQuantity  int = 1
availabilityStatus  varchar?
weight  numeric(10,2)?
dimensionsWidth / Height / Depth  numeric?
    (embedded Dimensions → { width, height, depth })
warrantyInformation  varchar?
shippingInformation  varchar?
returnPolicy  varchar?
barcode  varchar UNIQUE? (generated on create)
qrCode  varchar?
thumbnail  varchar?
createdAt / updatedAt  timestamp
reviewCount  virtual: COUNT(reviews)

# product_images
id  PK
url  varchar
position  int = 0 (keeps image order)
productId  FK → products  ON DELETE CASCADE

# reviews
id  PK
rating  int
comment  text?
date  timestamp
reviewerName  varchar
reviewerEmail  varchar
productId  FK → products  ON DELETE CASCADE

# product_tags (join table)
productId  FK → products
tagId  FK → tags

# tags
id  PK
name  varchar UNIQUE

# Notes
• synchronize: true → tables are auto-created from the entities
• numeric columns use a transformer: string → number
• tags: findOrCreateTags() reuses existing names
• duplicate sku / barcode → 409 Conflict (pg code 23505)
• deleting a product cascades to images, reviews, product_tags
